name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
🐛 "Refresh from issue" no longer clears assignees set in the planner. While direct editing of YouTrack fields is off, the planner may not write the assignee back to the issue, so the role field there stays empty by construction — and that emptiness used to come back as a removal, wiping the whole distribution in one press, silently and for good. An empty value from YouTrack now counts only when the planner writes to that field itself.

🐛 The capacity bar in Backlog work overstated the available resource sixtyfold — the "demand exceeds capacity" warning practically never fired.

🐛 A failed project load looked like an empty project. Failures now show as a bar until resolved, and a hanging request is cut off by a deadline instead of leaving stale data under a new header.

🐛 A stale role snapshot outside the sprint's own set silently locked the sprint read-only; the check now looks at the sprint's own roles and names whatever blocks it.

🌐 Language and dates. The project settings page, Backlog work and Stand-up now follow a language switch without a reload; dates in the release card and export, on the Gantt chart and in reporting follow the planner language instead of the browser locale.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
